trans-unit.source: A method commonly found in ancient Chinese dictionaries and rhyming books to specify the reading of an ideograph. The method uses two ideographs to specify a reading: the first one shares the same initial part, and the second one shares the same final part. For example, 德 (tək) and 紅 (ɣuŋ) are used to indicate the Middle Chinese reading of 東 (tuŋ), and therefore the Fanqie property value of U+6771 東 is the ideograph pair 德紅. The method uses a third and final ideograph, which can be either 反 or 切 (the two ideographs that correspond to Fanqie), and is therefore not included as part of the Fanqie property value.
trans-unit.target: 古代漢語字書與韻書中常用的一種標註字音的方法（反切）。該方法使用兩個漢字來標註一個字音：上字取聲母，下字取韻母與聲調。例如，「德」(tək) 和「紅」(ɣuŋ) 用於標註「東」(tuŋ) 的中古音，因此 U+6771「東」的反切屬性值為雙字「德紅」。反切通常包含第三個字「反」或「切」，因此不計入反切屬性值中。

If enabled, if the font has a typographic variant glyph mapped as a Unicode character, typographic variants will be copied as their Unicode mapped characters.
This will break glyph mapping when changing font and spellchecking, but is the only way to copy typographic variants successfully between applications.
Not all fonts present typographic variants as mapped characters.
trans-unit.target:
若啟用，當字型具有對應為 Unicode 字元的排版變體字形時，排版變體將以其對應的 Unicode 字元複製。
這會在變更字型和拼字檢查時中斷字形對應，但這是在應用程式之間成功複製排版變體的唯一方法。
並非所有字型都會將排版變體表示為對應字元。

trans-unit.source: Copy typographic variants as mapped Unicode characters
trans-unit.target: 將排版變體複製為對應的 Unicode 字元
